sermons.title: Sermon 2068 | Nathanael—the Man Needed for the Day

scripture.verse: "Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"

sermons.title: Sermon 2070 | Christ's Connection With Sinners the Source of His Glory

scripture.verse: "Therefore wiil I divide Him a portion with the great. And He shall divide the spoil with the strong. Because He has poured out His soul unto death. And He was numbered with the transgressors. And He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors."

sermons.title: Sermon 2071 | Trembling at the Word of the Lord

scripture.verse: "To this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit and trembles at My Word."
"Jesus said unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples dared ask Him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord."
"Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ."'Acts 20:21

sermons.title: Sermon 2074 | Intimate Knowledge of the Holy Spirit

scripture.verse: "The Spirit of Truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it sees Him not, neither knows Him; but you know Him, for He dwells with you and shall be in you."

sermons.title: Sermon 2075 | Our Lord's Entrance Within the Veil

scripture.verse: "Not with the blood of goats and calves, but with His own blood He entered the Most Holy Place once and for all, having obtained eternal redemption for us."

sermons.title: Sermon 2076 | Sounding Out the Word of the Lord

scripture.verse: "For from you sounded out the Word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia but also in everyplace your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak anything."
